note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). Convertible to skill-creator's eval format; run via its description-tuning loop or manual fresh-session baseline.

cases.prompt: Audit this SKILL.md and tell me what's wrong
Critique the skill I just wrote
Score this skill against the standards
This skill misfires constantly — review it
Write me a new skill for migrations
How should skill descriptions be written?
decide whether this sprawling skill should split into several
Prove the routing still works after my description edit.
